claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 18650 2200mAh 20A as a 2200mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.
The AW IMR 18650 2200mAh 2016 test documents a red wrapper, button-top construction, and dimensions of 18.15 mm × 65.6 mm.

The AW IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2016-09-14 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: The 2016 red button-top wrapper is documented, but no manufacturer verification path or batch-specific authenticity evidence was identified.
checks: Compare wrapper, label, and hologram details against a known-good AW sample.
Use a specialist retailer with a documented supply chain.
